2|Understanding can be investigated as learning executable distinctions through tests, costs and evidence.|Establish the central proposal and epistemic limits.|49,50,51,53|Order of permission operations is a checkable distinction.|51|The architecture is proposed, numerical examples are instructional and independent scientific review has not occurred.|53,69,70

4|Representations induce partitions of ignored differences; refinement and dependency structures make changes precise.|Supply mathematical vocabulary for executable distinctions.|98,101,104,105,108,109,112|A source-preservation invariant makes provenance inspectable without making sources true.|113|Tests are not universal proofs, proofs do not validate worldly models and computable solutions can be impractical.|114,116,117

5|Interpreters need declared contracts, stable semantics and separate working and consolidated states.|Connect representation to safe composition and revision.|144,145,148,149,150,153,159,161|Last known event and last real event have different completeness assumptions despite compatible formats.|154,155|Partial correctness excludes a termination guarantee; probabilities and structural compatibility do not imply universal semantic correctness.|153,156

6|Probability estimates, loss-based choices and evidential support are different objects.|Prevent utility optimization from altering epistemic claims.|174,175,176,178,179,182,184|The fictional asymmetric-loss decision threshold is 100/101, not 0.5.|174,175|Calibration depends on representative data; abstention has a cost and legitimate preferences do not change truth probabilities.|176,180,182

7|A sufficient representation preserves every distinction needed by a declared test family, with information and computation considered separately.|Establish the loss bound and learning as refinement.|190,192,194,195,196,197,204,205,208,210|Opposite orderings compressed to the same event set cannot exceed 50% expected accuracy when equiprobable and no side channel exists.|199,200,201,202|The source archive may enable a new distinction, but discarded information cannot be restored by computation and current sufficiency is not universal.|196,201,206,208

8|State must preserve distinctions relevant to continuations and valid updating, not only the current answer.|Ground learned distinctions in active automata learning.|214,215,232,235,238,239,240,242|Inactive and pending both deny access now but differ after confirmation.|214,215|Real tests generally replace ideal equivalence oracles; no counterexample found is not equivalence proved, and resets have costs.|244,246,247,250

9|Predictive equivalence compares test distributions; intervention effects require their own data and assumptions.|Separate stochastic representation from causal identification.|254,255,258,259,260,266,267,268,271,272|Common-cause and mediated binary models share observational X=Y but differ when X is fixed.|266,267|Low rank is an estimated structure, coefficients need not be probabilities and internal refinement cannot create missing worldly evidence.|263,264,269,271,272

10|Abstract domains make selected properties available through sound approximation, with precision and cost traded explicitly.|Ground interpretive plurality in established verification methods.|279,280,281,283,284,287,289,292|Independent intervals lose x=y and return a broad difference while a relational domain proves zero.|280,281|Empirical success does not prove abstract soundness; fixed-point iteration needs stopping mechanisms and incomplete verification remains qualified.|285,292,295,296,298

11|Diagnosis must distinguish computation errors, representation loss, missing observations, randomness, rule changes and ambiguous targets.|Specify the transition from incident to justified repair.|304,305,309,310,311,312,313,314,315,316,317,318,319,320,321,322,323,324,325,326,329,330,343|Contrastive changes of identity, irrelevant events and interleaving distinguish reusable order rules from memorized exceptions.|335,337,338|CEGAR's spurious counterexamples differ from prediction errors; lost histories cannot be reconstructed reliably and test transformations require valid invariances.|333,334,339,341,342,345,346

12|Induction composes declared typed primitives into programs whose reuse and total cost must be independently evaluated.|Explain candidate generation and consolidation.|350,351,355,356,358,360,361,363,364,365,373|Grouping by identity, selecting a last event and interpreting its type can become a parameterized shared program.|363|Types and brevity do not establish truth; program equivalence is restricted and held-out evaluation cannot be reused adaptively without consequences.|352,360,367,368,369,371,372

13|Computations and interpreter construction are actions whose expected decision benefits must outweigh full lifetime costs.|Connect metareasoning, complementarity and reuse.|377,378,379,384,388,390,394,395,396|Two individually unhelpful bit observations jointly determine whether bits differ; interpreter investment of 1,000 ms amortizes after 34 uses under stated costs.|386,387,395|Bounded selection must be compared with simple policies, and optimizing supplied utility does not determine legitimate human objectives.|390,391,392,398,399

14|Episodes, representations and interpreter libraries retain different things; transfer depends on applicability contracts and preserved provenance.|Explain long-term knowledge and revision.|403,404,405,407,408,409,411,412,413,415,417,419,420,421|A last-event rule transfers between permission and preference but not to cumulative bank balances.|412,413|Retirement must preserve old results; low-frequency capabilities matter and source repetition is not independent evidence.|408,409,415,416,417

16|Convex preference regions and cones follow from fixed procedures and expected utilities; other geometric claims need separate tests.|Demystify geometry and coordinate compression.|454,455,461,462,463,464,465,466,467,468,473,475,476,482,483|Squared radius makes annulus membership simple by discarding angle, leaving directional questions unanswered.|478,479,480|Cones are not all concepts, entailment and utility cones differ, and simple tables may outperform attractive geometries.|462,473,475,476,482,483

17|An atlas organizes local representations connected by executable adapters that declare preserved information.|Explain plural views without imposing a geometric manifold.|487,488,489,491,492,495,496,499,501|Formal access rights and an unavailable connection can coexist without contradiction because their targets differ.|495|Round trips on examples do not prove equivalence; selection and reconciliation costs may exceed a common model's costs.|493,497,503,504,505

18|A minimal MRP environment tracks tasks, episodes, representations, interpreters, evidence, incidents and library changes.|Make the proposed architecture implementable and attributable.|510,511,512,517,520,523,526,529,532,535,538,542,543,549,550,551,553|A cryptographic identity detects artifact change; the epistemic register distinguishes exact calculation from incomplete-observation estimates.|539,549,550|The environment is not an existing product; uniform interfaces do not imply uniform trust and names do not establish component value.|510,545,547,554,555

19|Candidates require explicit lifecycle states, stable execution epochs and complete dependencies for revision.|Connect learning to reproducibility and effect control.|559,581,583,584,585,586,588,589,590,595,596,597,598|A permission interpreter is tested on reversed order and interleaved keys, while the proof remains conditional on the input log.|583,584,585,586|Consolidation is not proof, transactions cannot undo arbitrary external effects and sandboxing does not establish correctness.|581,590,592,593,594,600,601

21|Bounded software and protocol analysis is the proposed first domain because properties and executions can be controlled.|Translate the mechanism into a falsifiable application.|631,632,635,636,637,640,641,642,645,646,647,649,650|An invariant must hold initially, be preserved and imply the target; a protocol version change should preserve reproducible older results.|642,645,646|Fixed-library selection may supply the entire advantage, and first adoption should be advisory under clear specifications.|638,651,653,654
